messages:
maria: heads-up — we're seeing a cascading 500+ error in the inference router for queued requests since ~00:12 UTC. reproduction on staging with same sequence length. spinning up a quick bridge to triage, please join if you can. severity: P1 for customer-impacting flows.
ops-bot: Bridge created: https://meet.redwood.ai/bridge/abc123 (voice + pinned notes).
alex: on my way. any quick logs or stack traces?
sahil: pinging on-call. looking at logs now — seeing repeated 'kv cache miss -> fallback to full decode' spikes. attaching sample: ```2026-03-17T00:11:57Z ERROR router.go:213 handleReq: fallback decode timeout=120ms req_id=xyz status=INTERNAL```
jenn: I can grab metrics/dashboards. alert threshold spiked at 00:10. linking slow query panel — https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/234/latency?orgId=1
maria: thanks. agenda for the bridge: 1) quick repro and rollback plan 2) test a config toggle to force non-prefetch path 3) if ok, rollout hotfix with canary 4) capture RCA owner + follow-up RFC for caching change.
leo: if we need a quick mitigation, we can temporarily route heavy seqs to the cost-tier model. I can prepare routing patch.
sahil: verified a couple of requests that hit seq > 2048 correlate with the fallback path. looks like quantized kernel selector misclassifying for those lengths. adding logs: ```selector: model=redwood-v2-8q seq=2300 chosen_kernel=fp16_fallback```
maria: @sahil @leo great — can one of you try the routing patch + restart of router instance in staging? timeline: 15–20m.
ops-bot: jenn joined the call.
alex: started a hotfix branch: `hotfix/router-routing-20260317`. pushing a quick canary to one replica. CLI: `infractl deploy --service=router --image=sha256:deadbeef --replicas=1 --tag=canary`
jenn: metrics show decreased 5xx on canary after routing change. still validating.
leo: rolling patch to 10% traffic. ops-bot: Rollout: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% (manual).
sahil: can we add a short-term metric to alert on fallback-rate per-model? I'll add to the dashboard.
maria: itemized follow-ups from bridge: - owner: @sahil for RCA - owner: @alex for hotfix PR and rollout notes - owner: @jenn for dashboard alerts - owner: @leo for routing RFC draft (due EOD tomorrow)
alex: filing PR now, will include test plan + rollback steps.
jenn: created dashboard alert: `fallback_rate > 0.05 for 5m` and muted noisy lower priority alerts.
sahil: initial RCA note: kernel selector treats any seq > 2048 as incompatible due to a brittle boundary in heuristics. will propose a unit test and a fallback metric in RFC.
maria: also scheduling a short design review / RFC readout tomorrow 16:00 UTC to discuss long-term cache/routing changes. can folks who will present add 1 slide each with proposal and tradeoffs.
leo: I can present routing alternatives. alex can present hotfix vs rework plan. sahil will present selector fixes.
maria: thanks everyone. if anything changes ping here. closing bridge in 30m once canary stabilizes. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Bridge closed by maria at 00:48 UTC.
